text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of summer training 
camp. Yaeno Muteki listens closely to 
Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan about 
the condition of their injuries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she can still train, returning to 
races is expected to take quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki vowed that she would 
definitely run a race in the Kikuka Sho 
that would make neither of them ashamed.
